authority: Source-bound display lens. Original assets and producers retain content and evidence authority.
graphEffect: No new Source Graph identity, relation, Study, Family or canonical count.
claimBoundary: Owner mnemonic tags are navigation vocabulary, not computed variables or evidence of one mechanism.

assets.title: IEEE Field Reconstruction
assets.reading: Sampled state-gradient density before the clean V69 stream construction.
assets.boundary: Grid occupancy and bright corners are representation effects until support, interpolation and boundary handling are tested.
assets.relation: Opens the Core reconstruction lane.

assets.title: Clean Field + Stream Structure
assets.reading: The familiar purple field, reconstructed path and white stream family.
assets.boundary: Streamlines are constructed from the implemented field; they do not certify causal flow.
assets.relation: Primary field plate for the existing demonstrator.

assets.title: Real Frame Transition
assets.reading: A visual handoff between two generated representations.
assets.boundary: Tweening is a display operation, not an observed physical transition.
assets.relation: Connects reconstruction frames without merging their operators.

assets.title: Resolution Sensitivity
assets.reading: The same field reconstructed at several grid resolutions.
assets.boundary: Visible agreement or disagreement is a diagnostic, not proof of invariance.
assets.relation: Adds the requested grid before motif reading.

assets.title: Boundary Extraction Engine
assets.reading: Orbit classes, distance, separatrix candidates, projection and switching zone in one report.
assets.boundary: The plotted boundaries inherit the prototype classes and thresholds.
assets.relation: Structure becomes an explicit boundary object.

assets.title: Transition Cost Map
assets.reading: A target-centered cost field exposes the narrow splinter-like passage.
assets.boundary: Cost is defined by the prototype; the wedge is not automatically a physical gate.
assets.relation: Introduces navigation cost over extracted structure.

assets.title: Cost Navigation Field
assets.reading: Direction arrows and sample paths are laid over the cost landscape.
assets.boundary: Directional alignment follows the constructed objective and is not a universal optimum.
assets.relation: Turns structure into a candidate flow instruction.

assets.title: Failure / Reachability Map
assets.reading: The splinter passage is isolated as a reachability region.
assets.boundary: Reachability belongs to this discretization, dynamics and stopping rule.
assets.relation: Separates possible passage from surrounding field.

assets.title: Controlled Splinter Crossing
assets.reading: Controlled trajectories probe the boundary from the launch region.
assets.boundary: A plotted crossing does not establish robustness or safety beyond the fixture.
assets.relation: Tests navigation against the extracted splinter.

assets.title: Minimal Control Energy
assets.reading: A control-strength map around the passage and target.
assets.boundary: The score is not physical energy in an external unit.
assets.relation: Adds effort to reachability.

assets.title: Optimal Crossing Direction
assets.reading: Candidate crossing directions are evaluated over the field.
assets.boundary: Optimality is internal to the declared objective and discretization.
assets.relation: Adds direction to the control surface.

assets.title: Field Alignment Consistency
assets.reading: Alignment of the proposed direction field with the existing flow geometry.
assets.boundary: High alignment is internal consistency, not external validation.
assets.relation: Checks whether navigation and field tell the same local story.

assets.title: Extracted Transition Structure
assets.reading: An adaptive extraction of transition geometry.
assets.boundary: Extracted marks depend on thresholds and neighborhood rules.
assets.relation: Compresses the field into a transition carrier.

assets.title: Transition Ridge
assets.reading: A sparse ridge readout of the transition structure.
assets.boundary: Sparsity is produced by the extractor and must not be read as completeness.
assets.relation: Prepares a compact boundary object for V8 checks.

assets.title: Lyapunov Stability Field
assets.reading: A stability landscape with declared comparison points.
assets.boundary: The plotted exponent is derived from this model and sampling scheme.
assets.relation: Tests whether the boundary coincides with instability.

assets.title: Boundary vs Lyapunov Ridge
assets.reading: The cyan splinter boundary and white Lyapunov ridge do not overlap here.
assets.boundary: IoU=0 is preserved as a negative result for these masks, not as universal independence.
assets.relation: Keeps boundary and instability separate.

assets.title: Distance to Boundary vs Lyapunov
assets.reading: Spatial distance and stability are compared directly.
assets.boundary: The trend summarizes this sampled field; it is not a general law.
assets.relation: Measures separation instead of relying on visual similarity.

assets.title: Lyapunov Along Boundary
assets.reading: Weak points are sampled along normalized boundary arc length.
assets.boundary: Peaks depend on boundary ordering and threshold.
assets.relation: Turns the boundary into a one-dimensional diagnostic carrier.

assets.title: Injection Tests from Gate Points
assets.reading: Perturbed paths are injected from extracted weak points.
assets.boundary: Displayed convergence is local to the test family and does not eliminate other branches.
assets.relation: Challenges candidate gates with trajectories.

assets.title: True Decision Gates
assets.reading: The declared comparison does not find branching decision points.
assets.boundary: This null result must not be rewritten as absence under every model.
assets.relation: Closes the gate test without forcing a positive story.

assets.title: Decision Skeleton
assets.reading: A sparse skeleton derived from the decision structure.
assets.boundary: Skeleton pixels are representation-dependent extraction products.
assets.relation: A compact handoff from fields to graph candidates.

assets.title: Clean Decision Graph
assets.reading: Cleaned graph candidates from the extracted skeleton.
assets.boundary: Cleanup removes material by rule; absent edges are not impossible transitions.
assets.relation: Prepares the V9 transport view.

assets.title: Orbit Entry Map
assets.reading: A large annular entry region with a small nested inner channel.
assets.boundary: Orbit entry is defined by this prototype classification and grid.
assets.relation: Makes the Matryoshka reading explicit without turning it into an operator.

assets.title: Orbit Entry Channels
assets.reading: Candidate channels around outer and inner orbit boundaries.
assets.boundary: Channel pixels are not automatically traversable paths.
assets.relation: Extracts passages from the V9.4 map.

assets.title: True Orbit Entry Channels
assets.reading: The filtered channel mask over the annular entry field.
assets.boundary: ‘True’ is historical script terminology, not a universal truth claim.
assets.relation: Filters candidates under the script rule.

assets.title: Direction Field on Entry Channels
assets.reading: Angular direction is evaluated on entry channels.
assets.boundary: Colors are local phase angles in the implemented field.
assets.relation: Adds orientation to passage geometry.

assets.title: Transport Map · Entry to Outcome
assets.reading: Entry samples wind toward a compact outcome region.
assets.boundary: Transport lines are simulated under the prototype dynamics.
assets.relation: Moves from local direction to outcome mapping.

assets.title: Transport Map · Symmetry Broken
assets.reading: The transport family opens into an asymmetric fold.
assets.boundary: Symmetry breaking is model-defined, not inferred from appearance alone.
assets.relation: Tests transport under changed symmetry.

assets.title: Multi-Regime Transport
assets.reading: Several transport regimes share one frame.
assets.boundary: Color families are model regimes, not physical substances.
assets.relation: Expands transport beyond one regime.

assets.title: Dynamic Regime Field
assets.reading: A compact active regime remains inside the broader carrier.
assets.boundary: The active region inherits the model threshold and temporal rule.
assets.relation: Compresses transport into a dynamic field state.

assets.title: Regime Map
assets.reading: The complete grid is classified into regime labels.
assets.boundary: Labels are algorithm output classes without independent scientific identity.
assets.relation: Turns dynamic transport into a categorical map.

assets.title: Boundary Strength
assets.reading: Transition intensity concentrates along regime boundaries.
assets.boundary: Intensity is the script score and has no external physical unit here.
assets.relation: Returns regime classes to a continuous signal.

assets.title: Boundary · Separatrix
assets.reading: A binary skeleton across the regime map.
assets.boundary: The historical ‘separatrix’ title is bounded to this extraction.
assets.relation: Closes the V2–V10 sequence.

assets.title: Structure Comparison Under Noise
assets.reading: Oscillatory and real-signal traces are compared under noise.
assets.boundary: This retained demo is not a new validation run and receives no claim upgrade.
assets.relation: Tests the reading under a changed carrier.

assets.title: Noise Robustness
assets.reading: A robustness summary retained with this module.
assets.boundary: The bench verifies file provenance only; it does not replay the benchmark.
assets.relation: Adds a stress-test lane.

assets.title: Rotating Contributions → Gate Candidates
assets.reading: Rotating contributions, a ζ-like path and coherence minima together.
assets.boundary: Gate candidates are threshold products, not physical gate mechanisms.
assets.relation: A bounded bridge from interference to transition candidates.

assets.title: Zeta × NEXAH Bridge
assets.reading: Interference, field structure, coherence and candidates remain distinct layers.
assets.boundary: The visual does not prove Zeta and NEXAH are one mechanism.
assets.relation: Relates the lens without collapsing carriers.

assets.title: The NEXAH Lens
assets.reading: Top view, 3D projection, signal and coherence expose multiple views.
assets.boundary: Each panel retains its own representation contract.
assets.relation: The Matryoshka principle as declared views.

assets.title: Full Structure vs Ghost Snake
assets.reading: The repo already contains an explicit ghost/snake comparison.
assets.boundary: Ghost, mouth, blindfold, bud and flower are owner mnemonics unless an algorithm defines them.
assets.relation: Provides the friendly-ghost reading without relabeling computed features.

assets.title: Grid vs Field
assets.reading: A declared comparison between discrete support and continuous-looking field.
assets.boundary: This explains a distinction; it does not establish equivalence.
assets.relation: Names the carrier distinction behind the bench.
